title: Santa's Countdown
description: An animated countdown to Christmas: a different scene each time it comes round.

display_duration.description: Seconds to show it in normal rotation

scenes.title: Scenes
scenes.description: Which scenes to show. They take turns; leave all ticked for the full set.

order.title: Order
order.description: in_turn shows the scenes one after another; random picks a different one each time

time_format.title: Clock
time_format.description: 12-hour (4:32:15 PM) or 24-hour (16:32:15) time on the clock scene

nice_list.title: Nice List names
nice_list.description: Names Santa writes on his Nice List and ticks, two to a scroll. Leave it empty for EVERYONE.

home_name.title: Home name
home_name.description: Your town, for the Santa tracker: it shows as the place Santa is over in the hour it is midnight at home (e.g. DALTON)

home_location.title: Home location
home_location.description: Latitude, longitude of home for the Santa tracker's map (e.g. 34.77, -84.97): it blinks white. Leave it empty for no dot. The time zone is the core's.

season_start.title: Season starts
season_start.description: Month-day to start showing (e.g. 11-01 or 12-01). It stays up through Christmas Day and is off the rest of the year.

animation_fps.description: Animation steps per second in normal rotation

vegas_animation_hz.description: Animation steps per second while it scrolls in Vegas mode. The ticker caps this (1 per second with the stock rgbmatrix binding); match it to that cap so each redraw is a new step.
